verdict.rationale: PagerDuty's Shift Agent is documented to detect calendar conflicts, find qualified replacements and coordinate schedule changes without manual intervention, which covers requesting coverage without an admin rebuilding the schedule. A community comment confirms calendar overrides exist but calls them clunky. Mobile Schedules appears only as a doc title. Missing for 10: explicit first-party docs that a non-admin engineer can create overrides themselves, a documented shift-swap workflow, permission details for self-service changes, and hands-on corroboration of Shift Agent.
